en.answer: When resolving the effect of <<11856>>, even if you no longer have a "Red-Eyes" monster on your side of the field, the targeted Normal Monster is still Special Summoned.
en.question: If the first effect of <<11856>> is activated, but <<5914>> is chained, so that when resolving this effect you no longer control a "Red-Eyes" monster, will the effect that Special Summons a Normal Monster still apply?
